initial_findings.finding: Reminder-target query could resolve after the editor's first focus attempt, leaving focus off the target selector.
initial_findings.resolution: Editor focus effect now retries when target-editor readiness changes; component coverage exercises asynchronous options.

initial_findings.finding: When backend review remained incomplete, the pending response could close the editor and discard the user's ability to continue correcting it.
initial_findings.resolution: The editor remains open on an awaiting-approval response and explains that the refreshed review is incomplete or still conflicting.

additional_findings.finding: Legacy update_event previews treated explicit null start/end fields as invalid instead of preserving the existing values, so a title-only update could be unreviewable.
additional_findings.resolution: Preview now falls back to the current event times for null fields; backend regression test covers a title-only update with both time fields null.

additional_findings.finding: A mutate_events update could be approved against a stale expected_version when the event changed after proposal creation but remained conflict-free.
additional_findings.resolution: Fresh review detects version drift, updates the pending operation to the current version, explains the refresh, and requires a separate decision. Pending review attempts retain their idempotency key, so replaying the same request cannot approve it. Backend regression test covers the refresh, same-key replay, and second confirmation.

follow_up.notes: Final read-only recheck found no remaining reproducible scoped P1/P2. Verified null-time mutation editor prefill preserves the existing time unless changed, single-end edits preserve the other endpoint, stale approve/edit refreshes remain pending until a new decision, and existing async focus, fail-closed, schema-stripping, and interval-validation fixes.

scope_limits: Source and automated interaction evidence only; no live AgentRun or human participant study.
